name.ja: 1/1 ガンプラくんDXセット(ランナーVer.再現パーツ付き)
name.en: 1/1 Gunpla-kun DX set (Runner Ver. with reproduction parts)

description.ja: ついに「ガンプラくん」が色付き版で登場！選択式でランナー状態でもディスプレイが可能！おなじみの装備も付属。素材にはLIMEXを採用。LIMEXに多色成形が実現されていることは史上初。
description.en: "Gunpla-kun" is finally available in colored version! You can select it and display it even in Runner state! Familiar equipment is also included. The material is LIMEX. This is the first time in history that LIMEX has been molded in multiple colors.

description.ja: • LIMEXを初の多色成型で採用！環境配慮とプラモデルの楽しさを両立したニューアイテム！
description.en: • First multi-color molding using LIMEX! A new item that combines environmental friendliness and the fun of plastic models!

description.ja: • ガンプラくんの通常時とランナーVer.を選択式でディスプレイ。
description.en: • Gunpla-kun's normal state and Runner Ver. are selectively displayed.

description.ja: • ビーム・ライフル、ビーム・サーベル、シールドのお馴染みの武装も付属。
description.en: • Beam rifle, beam saber, and Seal's familiar weapons are also included.

description.ja: LIMEXとは、主原料が石灰石を５０％以上含み、従来の石油由来樹脂の使用を大きく削減する＜地球環境に優しい新素材＞です。
description.en: LIMEX is a new material that is environmentally friendly and contains more than 50% limestone as its main raw material, greatly reducing the use of conventional petroleum-derived resins.
